sources.entry: Karakeep - Bookmark-everything app with a touch of AI for the data hoarders out there. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker
Karakeep | Bookmark-everything app with AI-based tagging and full-text search

summary.one_liner: Karakeep (formerly Hoarder) is a self-hostable bookmark-everything app with AI-based tagging, full-text and semantic search, and browser/mobile clients.
summary.what_it_does: Karakeep lets you save links, plain notes, images and PDFs in one place, and automatically fetches link titles, descriptions and images. Saved items can be sorted into lists that others can collaborate on. Content is searchable by full text and semantically, and LLM-based features provide automatic tagging and summarization, with local models via Ollama supported. It also includes full page archival using monolith, automatic video archiving with yt-dlp, OCR for text in images, and a rule-based engine for managing bookmarks. Clients include Chrome, Firefox and Safari extensions, iOS and Android apps, a REST API, and a CLI. Other features listed are RSS-based auto hoarding, highlights, bulk actions, SSO, and importers from Chrome, Pocket, Linkwarden, Omnivore and Tab Session Manager.
use_cases: save and organize web links and articles
personal bookmark manager with AI tagging
archive web pages and videos to prevent link rot
how_to_run: See the Installation section of the project documentation (not included in the README text provided)
notable: Full page archival with monolith to protect against link rot
LLM-based auto-tagging and summarization with local Ollama model support
Browser extensions, iOS and Android apps, and offline mobile reading
Auto hoarding from RSS feeds and imports from several bookmark services
Official skills and a CLI for LLM agents
caveats: Hosted cloud option is a paid subscription (cloud.karakeep.app)
Relies on OpenAI or local LLM setup for AI features
Install steps are in external documentation, not in the README
